title: v1_93 / Editor
content: ## Editor ### Lightbulb improvements In the previous milestone, we improved the location where the Code Actions lightbulb icon is shown. We've now decided to set `editor.lightbulb.enabled` to `onCode` by default. This means that the lightbulb icon is only shown when the cursor is on lines with source code and will show up less frequently. ### Color theming for action lists The color of the action list control, such as the Code Action menu, can be configured by themes with the `editorActionList.background`, `editorActionList.foreground`, `editorActionList.focusForeground`, and `editorActionList.focusBackground` keys. By default, the action list control theme matches that of the Quick Pick and Command Palette. Get more info about [customizing a color theme](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/getstarted/themes#_customize-a-color-theme).
